title: 砸5200万美元：竟买不来，密歇根初选胜利？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Much of the nation's attention has focused on the great Lake State, Michigan's Democratic Senate primary, with us now from Detroit.
segments.zh: 全国关注聚焦于大湖州，密歇根州民主党参议员初选，现在底特律连线。

segments.en: Bloomberg opinion column has Ron Brownstein, Nancy Caffer with us as well.
segments.zh: 彭博观点专栏有罗恩·布朗斯坦，还有南希·卡弗。

segments.en: She's the editorial page editor for Detroit Free Press. Nancy, let me start with you.
segments.zh: 她是《底特律自由报》的社论版编辑。南希，先请你谈谈。

segments.en: Today, as I understand, the last day for early voting in the state of Michigan, and I look at the number from the Secretary of State's office, more than a million voters have cast
segments.zh: 今天，据我所知，是密歇根州提前投票的最后一天，我看了州务卿办公室的数据，已有超过一百万选民投了票。

segments.en: their ballots already. Just underline for us here the importance of this race, yes, for Michiganers, but for Democrats across this country as well.
segments.zh: 请为我们强调一下这场竞选的重要性，不仅对密歇根人，也对全国民主党人。

segments.en: Yeah, this, the control of the Congress, I think, runs through Michigan here.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为国会的控制权取决于密歇根。

segments.en: We've got a hugely consequential Senate race that's going to tell us a number of things.
segments.zh: 这场参议员竞选意义重大，将揭示许多问题。

segments.en: We've got progressive candidate Abdel El Fyad, far more centrist candidate, U.S. Rep Haley Stevens.
segments.zh: 有进步派候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔·法耶德，以及更中间派的候选人，美国众议员海利·史蒂文斯。

segments.en: So, there's a two sort of ideological choices, Democrats say, but we're also facing a test of what exactly money can do in a primary.
segments.zh: 所以，民主党人面临两种意识形态选择，但我们也面临一个考验：金钱在初选中究竟能起多大作用。

segments.en: Representative Stevens has $52 million in outside spending in this race.
segments.zh: 史蒂文斯众议员在这场竞选中获得了5200万美元的外部支出。

segments.en: And it's just, it's a 12 to 1 spending advantage over El Fyad, who has, I think, a stronger ground game, more of an organic kind of viral support.
segments.zh: 而且这只是对埃尔·法耶德的12比1的支出优势，我认为他有更强大的基层竞选活动，更有机的、病毒式的支持。

segments.en: And so we're looking at not just a choice in ideology, but then how money can communicate that ideology or the desirability of each candidate to voters.
segments.zh: 所以我们看到的不仅是意识形态的选择，还有金钱如何传达这种意识形态或每位候选人对选民的吸引力。

segments.en: I mean, Ron, I'm wondering what your take is on that, because we talk a lot about how money doesn't always equate to votes.
segments.zh: 罗恩，我想知道你的看法，因为我们经常谈论金钱并不总是等同于选票。

segments.en: We see a lot of times, especially candidates spending their own money on races.
segments.zh: 我们经常看到，尤其是候选人自己花钱竞选的情况。

segments.en: That's almost never successful, even though that's not necessarily the case here.
segments.zh: 这几乎从不成功，尽管这里的情况不一定如此。
